usedFor: Slide handles messages, TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers, and “When a voice call is completed” can start “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a voice call is completed” in Slide, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A finished voice call runs a command on your computers.

watchOut: “When a contact is updated” fires on every update, so “Trigger Command” can run more than once per contact.
